fact: The party successfully sneaks up on the Derro cultists and gains a surprise round.
source_quote: The party successfully sneaks up on the Derro cultists... the party gets a surprise round
subject: surprise attack

fact: The death dog's handler is busy grooming the dog to avoid his screaming boss.
source_quote: The death dog's handler fails to notice them because he's busy grooming the dog to avoid his screaming boss
subject: Derro cultist handler

fact: The DM rules that a readied action normally can't include movement but offers to allow half movement.
source_quote: The DM rules that a readied action normally can't include movement, but offers to allow half movement going forward
subject: DM ruling on readied action

fact: Zalthir creates a sphere of magical darkness to disorient the cultists.
source_quote: Zalthir creates a sphere of magical darkness to disorient the cultists
subject: sphere of magical darkness

fact: Narrak demands the intruders embrace Demogorgon's madness or break trying.
source_quote: "Demogorgon's madness flows through me! You, whoever you are, will embrace it or break trying."
subject: Narrak

fact: Zalthir uses his fire breath weapon on four enemies after stepping east.
source_quote: Zalthir, remembering he is a dragonborn, uses his fire breath weapon on four enemies after stepping east
subject: Zalthir fire breath

fact: Three enemies take 6 damage each and a fourth takes 3 damage from Zalthir's fire breath.
source_quote: three take 6 damage each, and a fourth takes 3
subject: fire breath damage

fact: Narrak mocks the party's fire attack, claiming his power is superior.
source_quote: Narrak mocks the party's fire attack, claiming his power is superior
subject: Narrak

fact: A Derro cultist steps out and stabs at the party with a short spear, chanting "You shall die!", but misses.
source_quote: A Derro cultist steps out and stabs at the party with a short spear, chanting "You shall die!", and misses
subject: Derro spear attack

fact: A Derro cultist strikes blindly from within the magical darkness and misses.
source_quote: Another, unable to see out of the darkness, strikes blindly from within it and also misses
subject: blind Derro attack

fact: Zalthir is gripped by a momentary madness from the ritual circle but shakes it off with monk's focus.
source_quote: Zalthir, standing at the edge of the ritual circle, is gripped by a momentary madness from it (a Wisdom save), but his monk's focus lets it subside
subject: Zalthir

fact: Gyrgum casts Tasha's Caustic Brew and catches four cultists.
source_quote: Gyrgum casts Tasha's Caustic Brew (a 30-by-5-foot line, DC 14 Dexterity) and catches four cultists
subject: Tasha's Caustic Brew

fact: One cultist dodges the brew while the rest take 2d4 acid damage at the start of each turn.
source_quote: Only one dodges, and the rest take 2d4 acid at the start of each turn
subject: caustic brew damage

fact: Thorin senses the circle's danger and charges a cultist instead of entering the circle.
source_quote: Thorin senses the danger and charges a cultist instead of running into the circle
subject: Thorin charges

fact: Daz's first fiery ray kills one of the tougher chanters.
source_quote: His first ray does 15 damage to one of the tougher chanters, which the DM put at 21 hit points, and the DM rules it dead
subject: chanters killed

fact: Daz turns his third ray on Grula-Munga, hitting for 8 damage.
source_quote: He turns his third ray on Grula-Munga (85 HP), hitting on a 14 for 8 damage
subject: Daz attacks Grula-Munga

fact: Grula-Munga shouts "Oh, brother!" and points at the attackers.
source_quote: Grula-Munga shouts "Oh, brother!" and points at the attackers
subject: Grula-Munga

fact: A Derro who heard the magic comes out and spears at Zalthir.
source_quote: A Derro who heard the magic comes out and spears at Zalthir
subject: Derro spear attack

fact: Narrak casts Fear, striking terror into Thorin, Gyrgum, and Zalthir and forcing them to flee.
source_quote: Narrak steps outside the darkness and retaliates by casting Fear, striking terror into Thorin, Gyrgum, and Zalthir and forcing them to flee
subject: Narrak casts Fear

fact: Gyrgum fails his saving throw against Fear because he did not use Bless on himself.
source_quote: Gyrgum rolls 11 without Bless (he blessed only the others)
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz is unaffected by Narrak's Fear spell.
source_quote: and Daz is unaffected
subject: Daz

fact: Grula-Munga's battle axe misses Thorin, but her morning star hits for 14 damage.
source_quote: Grula-Munga joins the fray; her battle axe misses Thorin (AC 18), but her morning star hits for 14 damage
subject: Grula-Munga attacks

fact: A Derro attacked by the caustic brew strikes at Zalthir, misses, and takes 4 acid damage.
source_quote: A caustic-brewed Derro attacks Zalthir and misses, then takes 4 acid damage
subject: Derro cultist

fact: Zalthir dashes away and repositions the sphere of magical darkness to block Narrak's line of sight.
source_quote: Zalthir dashes away, then repositions the sphere of magical darkness to block Narrak's line of sight
subject: Zalthir moves darkness

fact: The DM rules that moving the magical darkness was a free action.
source_quote: The DM ruled that moving the darkness was a free action
subject: DM ruling on darkness movement

fact: Zalthir uses his bonus action on Eldritch Maul, empowering his tattoo.
source_quote: Zalthir uses his bonus action on Eldritch Maul, empowering his tattoo
subject: Zalthir Eldritch Maul

fact: Zalthir's tattoo now allows his melee attacks to reach 15 feet and deal extra damage.
source_quote: so that his melee attacks reach 15 feet and deal extra damage
subject: tattoo

fact: Gyrgum passes his saving throw against Fear and shakes off the effect.
source_quote: Gyrgum, no longer seeing Narrak, passes his save and shakes off the fear
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum strikes Grula-Munga with a bolt of guiding light, marking her for a follow-up attack by Thorin.
source_quote: Gyrgum strikes Grula-Munga with a bolt of guiding light, marking the giant for a follow-up attack by Thorin
subject: Gyrgum guides Thorin

fact: Thorin hits Grula-Munga with his longsword for 16 total damage, leaving her at 54 hit points.
source_quote: His +1 longsword with advantage hits for 10, plus 6 from a special ability, for 16 total, leaving her at 54 hit points
subject: Thorin strikes Grula-Munga

fact: Thorin shakes off his fear.
source_quote: then shakes off his fear
subject: Thorin

fact: Daz conjures a hand of compacted earth that seizes and restrains Narrak, dealing bludgeoning damage.
source_quote: He conjures a massive hand of compacted earth that erupts from the ground to seize and restrain Narrak, dealing bludgeoning damage
subject: Daz restrains Narrak

fact: Narrak fails his Strength save, his concentration breaks, and the Fear ends.
source_quote: Narrak fails his Strength save, his concentration breaks, and the Fear ends
subject: Narrak concentration breaks

fact: Narrak defiantly proclaims the inevitability of the two-headed curse and Demogorgon's rise.
source_quote: Narrak, though trapped and injured, defiantly proclaims the inevitability of the two-headed curse and the rise of Demogorgon
subject: Narrak

fact: The session pauses mid-combat and will resume after Daz's turn.
source_quote: The session pauses mid-combat and will resume after Daz's turn
subject: session pause

fact: The DM adds Narrak's parting couplet after calling the stop.
source_quote: After calling the stop, the DM added Narrak's parting couplet
subject: session stop
